answer: Cap new seats: each epoch the forge mints only 12 identities, sold by sealed-bid auction with every winning bid burned, never paid to anyone. A sable bidder hiding 300 sockpuppets must outbid honest newcomers 300 times across 25 epochs, and each extra seat it wins lifts the clearing price for the next round. A falcon check also bars any one funding source from winning more than 2 seats per epoch, so the attack costs weeks plus a burn that grows with its size.
